steps.content: The mine is an inward-facing, ring-shaped structure that dams the contaminated waters to form a hollow, tiered interior. Each level ranges between a few dozen to a hundred meters high, and cascades onto lower platforms a dozen meters wide.

<size=29>The levels descend into the depths. Beyond the third level is total darkness. Contaminated liquids flow down the walls into the precipitation pools on the platforms. As long as the mine's Mania field is kept relatively low, the precipitation pool can continuously produce Hypercubes.</size>

<size=29>Too bad this grand structure has long stopped operating. The precipitation pool is now dirty and clogged, while the huge elevator to the side is broken. You can only use the safety rope to go down level after level, passing by remnants of the Black Ring that are suspended mid-air.</size>
Finally, you land on a wider platform. In this windless abyss, the only echoes are of Hella's complaints.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ... Ugh... Finally here... Whose idea was it to use that kind of rope to come down? What if a monster attacked in mid-air?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Don't worry, there aren't many "monsters" at this depth. People haven't come to Inner Bay for a long time, so there aren't any new Corruptors to be born, while the old Corruptors have all gone to DisSea. It's not that scary here.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: If you're really scared, I'll warn you in advance. There are only two things to watch out for—

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: One, <color=#fb9259>machines</color> that can still move.
She picks up a rock and hurls it to the contaminated precipitation pool a few meters away. Thud...

A lump of scrap iron suddenly jumps up from the ground. Bursting with sparks and flashing red light, it dashes towards the crowd. Before it manages to tackle you, a couple of elite Rustfire combatants knock it to the ground.
You see some familiar symbols on its rusty metal shell.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Nirvana. You've probably seen a lot of them on your way here.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: It's the sole Hypercube-producing giant and has a complete monopoly over the industry. It controls the Inner Bay Rail, all the mines and the mechs, as well as the entire trade network. Their power is formidable.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: The robots here are all old models. When no one is around to control them, the Mania field will cause them to have all sorts of malfunctions.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: But they have really incredible attack power. Regular gangsters are no match against them.

She puts on her gloves and presses a button. The robot stops moving and becomes a piece of scrap metal again. Raven wants to take a photo, but gives up when she discovers her camera isn't working. She looks up to see you staring at her.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Why are you staring at me?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Do you have to wear this outfit here too?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No need for you to carry out missions here, and I know that Rustfire hates the Executive Committee.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: It might be useful. There are some Nirvana security codes on this Executive Officer uniform. Maybe those cute little robots won't do anything to me.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I thought you didn't need to be scared of these things.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know you're very strong.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Yes... I am strong. I can control ink with my mind and make them do anything I want. In other words, every word I write is my weapon, but...

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: How can I use them as mere tools of violence? The ideas they hold are what truly gives them power! My writings should not dissipate like gunsmoke. They should last for all eternity!
...With her level of poetry?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Yes. I'm a poet, after all.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: As the saying goes: I can wield the sword to protect you, yet I must let it go to embrace you.
Before you can roll your eyes, someone taps you on the shoulder. It was an elite Rustfire combatant.

Having swaddled himself like a dumpling against Inner Bay's contamination, he points at Raven, gestures at you, then bows wildly a few times. You can feel his embarrassment and apology through the mask.
A shadowy figure suddenly tries to grab the combatant from behind.
But it doesn't have a clear face, and its facial features are constantly shifting. You realize this isn't a human being.

Your shackles pierce the figure but don't destroy it. The figure opens its mouth and lets out a bloodcurdling wail. Just as its hand is about to grab you, a slender streak of black wraps around you and pulls with astonishing strength.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: And that's the second thing to watch out for.

Raven extends her hands, letting the pages of her exquisite notebook fly in the wind. The words that flew out had saved your lives. The ink blots finally return to her ink bottle. For an avid performer like her, this must be a very chic pose.
Too bad it doesn't last long.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: F*** me, the sonnet I just wrote is gone...
